title: Dark Web & OSINT Credential Leak Scanner
goal: Integrate APIs like DeHashed or HaveIBeenPwned to scan for leaked credentials belonging to the target organization's domain. Flag exposed employee accounts and queue credential stuffing/spraying tasks (with approval) against exposed corporate VPNs or SSO portals.
generation_reason: To fill critical missing capabilities in the pentest program, transitioning it from a pure network/web scanner to a full-spectrum security validation platform.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Implement only the defined capability. Ensure the runner respects the ROE (Rules of Engagement) gate and requires explicit approval if it is active/intrusive.

success_criteria: Runner successfully integrates and executes its specific function.
Results are parsed and mapped into AegisPT findings format.
Intrusive actions are gated behind approvals.

acceptance_criteria: The new security capability functions safely within local lab environments and outputs standard findings.

out_of_scope: Building a custom C2 framework or Phishing tool from scratch (must integrate existing tools)
